Hong Kong's Sotheby's High Jewelry sale made HK$267.5 million, and ruby lots took the three highest prices of the day.

A Mauboussin ruby necklace led at HK$16 million, 1.45 times estimate; Cartier's tutti frutti earrings made HK$7.9 million, 9.3 times estimate. No diamond-led lot reached the top ten of 180-plus offered.

香港蘇富比高級珠寶拍賣售出2.675億港元，紅寶石首飾包辦全場最高三個成交價。莫布森紅寶石項鍊以1,600萬港元奪冠，超越預估1.45倍；卡地亞Tutti Frutti耳環以790萬港元成交，達預估9.3倍。逾180件拍品之中，無一件以鑽石為主導的拍品躋身十大。
